selection: DSG-Net = ConvNeXt-T + OCA + DOSE-Strip; all three seeds reported (no best-only selection); metrics from evaluate.py on each run's model_best.pth
training_protocol: single-stage, identical to convnext_tiny baseline: AdamW lr1e-4/wd5e-2, bs32, <=300ep, Cosine(300), AMP, early-stop 30, val macro-F1 selection, ImageNet ema init (14f3164e3ea6ac32ab3f574f528ce817696c9176fad4221e0a77a905a7360595), seeds 42/43/44

innovation_modules.A_OCA: orientation-coherence multiplicative gating after stage2/3, zero-init per-channel scales (+576 params)
innovation_modules.B_DOSE_strip: direction-gated 1x15/15x1 depthwise strips + composed diagonal responses at stage3 blocks 2/5/8, zero-init per-channel scales (+38016 params)

cle_ac_v1.paired_diff: +0.65pp, 2/3 positive; Kappa +0.95pp; 7/7 metrics positive on mean

budget_note: Structure was iterated adaptively on cle_ac test per user instruction; cross-domain (covid/busi/cub) tests were single-pass after freezing the design; all 34 runs retained, no cherry-picking; n=3 std is descriptive, not CI. Refinement arm (optional_refinement_arm) shares the same adaptive-iteration disclosure: lambda selected on cle_ac test with full scan reported.

optional_refinement_arm.what: DSG + 自一致类加权CAM叠加精炼 (λ=0.75, 训练+推理同口径预处理)
optional_refinement_arm.registry_model: convnext_tiny_cle_oca_strip (架构不变, 仅输入图像预处理)
optional_refinement_arm.protocol: 两阶段: 基模型(DSG自种子已训权重)生成类加权CAM -> x'=clip(x*(1+0.75*H)) 全数据集(train/val/test)叠加 -> 同协议从ImageNet ema重训; 推理时对输入先做同样叠加(2x前向)

cle_ac_v1.same_batch_control: 同日同批DSG原始x3与锚点逐位一致(0.9637/0.9741/0.9493) -> 排除批漂移
cle_ac_v1.variance_note: std 0.0102->0.0044 减半, s44型方差被抑制

caveats: λ经test反馈选出(0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0完整曲线如实呈现, 迭代已获用户授权)
推理需2x前向生成CAM; 仅训练叠加/测试原始图臂为负(-1.08@s42)
CAM空间随机打乱对照失效(-1.14), 类判别信号必要性有对照支撑
CLE-Net约定下λ=0.5的+0.82pp未迁移到codex约定(弱基座天花板恢复效应)
optional_refinement_arm.lambda_scan_note: 细粒度λ敏感区间[0.5,1.0]为锯齿(单种子噪声主导); 0.75=唯一3种子+同批对照验证为正的点, 不主张平滑最优

crossdomain.covid: 0.9974±0.0000, vs DSG +1.28pp 3/3, vs baseline +1.73pp 3/3 (近饱和, AUROC 1.0000)
crossdomain.cub: 0.7516±0.0091, vs DSG -3.55pp 0/3 — 强负, 细粒度纹理脆弱+λ数据集依赖
crossdomain.claim_scope: 精炼臂主张仅限源域cle_ac(+可选Covid); 不做跨域通用性主张
